'''FC CSKA 1948 Sofia''' ({{langx|bg|ФК ЦСКА 1948 София}}) is a [[Bulgaria]]n [[football club]] from [[Sofia]]. The team plays its home matches at the [[Stadion Bistritsa|Bistritsa Stadium]] and competes in Bulgaria's [[First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|First League]]. The colours of the club are red and white."}}
